name: t13-read-v4
idea_origin: DeepSeek line, 27 Oct night; ideas from Matteo's observed-growth-v10 (branch matteo/main): best value at the level, two-month review window, repair at once
hypothesis: An official t13-read-v2 game lost its first promotion when, two months before the review, DeepSeek chased a Network gain it could no longer take and lost two Output points. Recording the best value of Skill, Network and Output at the level (Matteo's observed-growth idea), protecting Network and Output over the last two months, repairing any loss at once, and detecting stalls from story choices too should keep more first promotions.
predicted_behaviour: First promotion at the first review more often than t13-read-v2/v3; no rise in trust crises.
refutation: Same or more missed first promotions than t13-read-v2/v3 in official games.
